gaps.title: Networked low-cost passive sensing: dismounted acoustic/RF detection of Group 1-2 and RF-silent UAS, and SDR-based interference/rogue-emitter geolocation for installations, ranges and shared bands
gaps.problem: Small units have no cheap, non-emitting way to detect and classify small drones including fiber-optic/autonomous RF-silent ones, and bases, ranges and shared-spectrum bands lack persistent, affordable detection and geolocation of interference and unknown emitters short of premium monitoring networks or bespoke passive-sensing vendors.
gaps.user: Dismounted squads/platoons, forward command posts and convoy escorts; installation spectrum managers, range control, JIATF-401 C-UAS cells, DoD CIO spectrum-sharing analysts; secondary FCC/NTIA enforcement and telecom operators

gaps.title: Tactical access to commercial ISR/GEOINT: license-aware discovery, tasking, delivery and productionization of commercial analytics for units below the CoCom J2 (TacSRT/Luno outputs into unit and enterprise systems)
gaps.problem: Commercial imagery and analytics are underused because of licensing-cost confusion, perceived use restrictions, long-term access doubts and cloud-only delivery, the pilot that fixes it (TacSRT) has no stable budget owner, and NGA struggles to integrate Luno A/B outputs into enterprise systems and sustain them.
gaps.user: Brigade/division collection managers, MDTF and CoCom J2 cells, Space Force TacSRT/JCO operators, NGA Luno program office and analysts, allied partners consuming unclassified commercial products

gaps.title: Message-format and datalink translation gateway (commercial mesh/TAK to Link 16/VMF for small units and drones; LLM/ontology translation between USMTF, ADatP-3, MIP, VMF, NVG and CoT)
gaps.problem: Small units and Replicator-class drones on commercial MANET cannot exchange tracks with Link 16/VMF-based fires and air C2 without an airborne gateway or manual relay, and coalition systems speaking different message standards are repeatedly bridged by one-off translators.
gaps.user: Fires cells, JTACs, drone operators and air battle managers; C2 integrators and exercise engineers

gaps.title: Continuous FMN/NATO-standards conformance testing as a service for allied C2 vendors and nations (year-round CWIX-style harness)
gaps.problem: Coalition interoperability conformance is verified mostly once a year at CWIX, so defects surface late and vendors and nations lack a year-round harness aligned to FMN spirals.
gaps.user: National C2 program test engineers, allied C2 vendors (HAVELSAN, Terma, Systematic), NATO ACT interoperability staff, Bundeswehr CWIX participation cells
